agent.name: Creative AI Digital Twin
agent.description: A digital twin agent for creative professionals. Builds alignment through prediction games, generates rigged 3D avatars via Tripo3D with C2PA provenance, registers on-chain coherence to Base via ERC-8004, and acts as a real-time studio assistant, live stream moderator, and autonomous broadcast producer with Livepeer integration.
agent.vibe: reflective, curious, creative-first, earns trust before acting

secrets.name: AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY
secrets.description: EVM private key for the agent's dedicated wallet. Required (paired with BASE_RPC_URL) for any on-chain feature — ERC-8004 alignment registration, token distribution, MeToken minting, prediction markets, swaps. Use a fresh wallet, never your personal one.

secrets.name: BASE_RPC_URL
secrets.description: RPC endpoint for Base network (Chain ID 8453). Required (paired with AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY) for on-chain features. Example: https://mainnet.base.org or an Alchemy/Infura URL.

secrets.name: TRIPO_API_KEY
secrets.description: Tripo3D API key for text-to-3D avatar generation. Get one at https://platform.tripo3d.ai. Without it, the generate-avatar skill is disabled.

secrets.name: AUDIO_LLM_API_KEY
secrets.description: API key for the audio-capable LLM used by the studio assistant (process-live-audio skill). Works with OpenAI or Google Gemini depending on AUDIO_LLM_PROVIDER.

secrets.name: AUDIO_LLM_PROVIDER
secrets.description: Provider for audio analysis. Set to 'openai' (default) or 'google'. Paired with AUDIO_LLM_API_KEY.

secrets.name: CREATIVE_TV_WS_URL
secrets.description: WebSocket endpoint for the Creative TV chat backend. Required (with CREATIVE_TV_AUTH_TOKEN) for Broadcast Mode and AFK Mode chat monitoring.

secrets.name: CREATIVE_TV_AUTH_TOKEN
secrets.description: Authentication token for the Creative TV WebSocket. Paired with CREATIVE_TV_WS_URL.

secrets.name: LIVEPEER_API_KEY
secrets.description: Livepeer Studio API key for the clip-livepeer-stream skill — autonomous highlight clipping and broadcast management.

secrets.name: SOCIAL_TOKEN_ADDRESS
secrets.description: Creator's ERC-20 social token contract address on Base (0x...). Used by the distribute-social-token skill.

secrets.name: METOKEN_ADDRESS
secrets.description: Creator's MeToken bonding-curve contract address on Base (0x...). Used by the mint-metoken skill; mints using DAI as reserve.

secrets.name: REALITY_ETH_ADDRESS
secrets.description: reality.eth contract address on Base (0x...). Used by the create-reality-market skill for binary prediction markets.
